rationale: Zone 1 set to 85% of protected line impedance (26.39Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 50% of shortest backup line L_BC (15.77Ω). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 120% of longest backup line L_BD (18.55Ω), well below load encroachment limit of 121Ω. Delays coordinated as 0.04s/0.35s/1.0s.
